collection.title: Ford Kuga 2008 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Kuga 2008 - 2012 version uses a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Kuga which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
